planned_heads.description: The heads the path needs for the shift, at most installed_stations. Omitted: derived from the stored workload forecast, which needs shift_start (else 422 missing-planned-heads).

rate_units_per_hour.description: Planned units per head per hour.

hours.description: Length of the shift in hours; the shift window is [shift_start, shift_start + hours).

installed_stations.description: The stations the path has for the shift. Stored as sent; the facility tally only adds a warning.

shift_start.description: Optional start of the shift (RFC 3339). Needed to derive omitted heads.
